Hints: What is 90 x 8? Think of 90 as 9 x 10
Solution: Eight equal groups of 90 trees give 8 x 90 = (8 x 9) x 10 = 72 x 10 = 720 trees.

Question Choices: A charity gives out 180 food bags to 6 groups evenly. How many bags per group?
Hints: Divide 180 by 6. Think of 180 as 18 x 10
Solution: 180 is 18 tens. Divide 18 tens among 6 groups: 18 divided by 6 = 3 tens per group, or 30 bags. Check 6 x 30 = 180.
